retrievalProfile.description: A stark, high-contrast black and white photographic landscape or figure overlaid with a thin, vibrant geometric rainbow arc and multi-layered display typography.
triggerTerms: stark black and white landscape with rainbow
excludeWhen: minimalist modern sans-serif layouts are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A composition defined by a binary black-and-white photographic base with heavy grain and blown-out highlights, bisected by a precise, multi-colored thin-line rainbow arc that provides the only source of color.
coreVisualRelationships: Stark black-and-white organic forms vs. geometric colored lines
Heavy photographic grain vs. clean vector-like rainbow
Top-aligned display text vs. bottom-weighted visual subject
Negative white space in the sky vs. dense black silhouettes
coreInvariants: High-contrast black and white base imagery
Visible film grain or halftone-like texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, dark silhouette occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame, suggesting a landscape or a reclining figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rainbow arc acts as the central focal point, bridging the dark silhouette and the light sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top-aligned title, follow the rainbow arc down into the dark silhouette, and rest on the bottom-right informational block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper third is dominated by high-contrast white 'sky' with scattered black cloud-like textures.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant spectral rainbow (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue for secondary informational overlays
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast (0% and 100%) in the background with high-saturation, mid-value lines in the rainbow.
paletteRestrictions: No muted or pastel versions of the rainbow colors

letterConstructionRules: Title uses multi-line inline strokes to create a 3D or vibrating effect
Secondary text uses tight tracking and rounded terminals
High x-height for all display elements
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters in the title are filled with horizontal or concentric hatching
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Inline decorative display paired with a clean, rounded geometric sans-serif for readability.

preserve: Rounded geometric skeleton for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, rounded geometric feel of the secondary text
Captures the multi-line inline decorative style of the title

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photograph of a reclining figure or landscape with heavy grain. Add a thin, 6-line concentric rainbow arc (red to purple) spanning the middle-right section. Leave the top third mostly white with sparse black cloud textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply the title in a multi-line inline geometric font at the top center. Place the subtitle in a rounded geometric sans-serif immediately below it. Add a light blue rectangular block in the bottom right corner containing technical tracklist-style text.

verificationChecks: Is the background strictly high-contrast black and white?
Is the rainbow composed of thin, distinct colored lines?
Is the grain texture visible across the entire image?
Is the title font multi-lined or inline?

adjustableVariables: Color of the informational overlay block
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or song titles
The specific record label logo in the corner
The exact phrasing of the promotional sticker
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rainbow does not have a blur or glow effect.
Verify the black areas are deep black without shadow detail.
Check that the text is legible against the high-contrast background.
Confirm the grain is coarse and photographic, not a digital noise filter.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast B&W photo + Thin-line rainbow arc + Multi-line display type = 70s Psychedelic Soul Aesthetic
